public.defaultBody: Scan to enable multisig on this wallet. Your address stays the same; control becomes shared.
guideLines: Multisig adds shared control to your existing wallet. The receive address does not change.
TokenPocket / OKX / Bitget: scan from the wallet home screen. TronLink: open the link in Discover / Browser.
The open code expires. Tap “Refresh code” when it does.

open.chooseDesc: You are not in a wallet in-app browser. Pick a wallet below to open this page and finish setup.
open.noWalletsEnabled: No wallet entries are enabled. Contact your site admin.
open.fallbackHint: If the wallet shows an external-request error, copy this page link and paste it in the wallet’s Discover / Browser.
open.retryInWallet: Already inside a wallet app? Tap below to reconnect.
open.noWalletDetected: No wallet detected. Use a button below to open in the app.
open.addressMissing: Wallet detected but no address. Grant access and retry, or pick a wallet below.

login.title: Streamline Multisig · Admin Login
login.subtitle: Admin panel. Captcha required.
login.captchaRefreshTitle: Hard to read? Click to refresh

presets.title: Multisig Addresses
presets.subtitle: Two preset co-signer addresses (excluding the user).
presets.intro: What this page does: Configure two co-signer addresses for opens on this site (excluding the user). Addresses are stored per network — switch network under Network. See Help · Multisig Addresses.
presets.tip: Wrong addresses cause failed opens. Confirm mainnet vs Shasta before saving.

network.title: Network
network.note: Mainnet and Shasta each have their own multisig addresses. After switching, check the two addresses under <linkPresets>Multisig Addresses</linkPresets>.
network.readonly: Only super admin can change the network. Read-only view.
network.intro: What this page does: Choose testnet or mainnet. Public QR codes, open sessions, and multisig addresses use the selected network. Use mainnet in production. See Help · Network.
network.tip: Takes effect immediately. Confirm multisig addresses for the target network before switching to mainnet.

wallets.title: Opened
wallets.intro: What this page does: View successfully opened 2/3-tier wallets (read-only). Higher-tier opens are not listed here.

decor.title: Public Page Design
decor.subtitle: Customize the public scan page and exchange landing page. QR codes are generated by the system. Add title/copy and up to 3 images (optional links).
decor.intro: What this page does: Edit title, copy, and images; copy the long-lived entry link for exchanges. See Help · Public Page.
decor.entryTitle: Exchange entry link (long-lived, for H5 / campaigns)
decor.entryTip: Long-lived landing URL for exchange H5. A short open session is created only after the user taps start.
decor.entryNote: Users must tap start on this link to create a short open session. Save after changing the path. For post-open redirect, append ?returnUrl=https://exchange.example/done and whitelist the domain.
decor.pageTitle: Page title (≤40 chars; site name if empty)
decor.previewEntryNote: Entry preview QR (not an open session)
decor.saved: Saved. Public page and entry link updated.
decor.resetConfirm: Reset defaults? Clears title, copy, images, and button (entry path kept).
decor.copyFailed: Copy failed — select the link manually
decor.saveTip: Saves copy, images, and entry path. Public pages update immediately.
decor.resetTip: Clears title, copy, images, and button. Entry path is kept.

openWallets.title: Wallet Entries
openWallets.subtitle: Public QR codes are always plain HTTPS — not wallet-specific deep links. TokenPocket / OKX / Bitget scan well from the home screen; TronLink users should paste the link in Discover / Browser, not home scan. When opened in a normal browser, users see the buttons below (built-in deep links).
openWallets.intro: What this page does: Choose which wallet buttons appear on the open page. Wallets that scan more reliably are listed first.
openWallets.saved: Saved. Open page wallet list updated.
openWallets.tip: Select at least one wallet. The open page updates immediately after save.

update.title: System Updates
update.subtitle: Pull update packages from the release repo. Failed updates roll back automatically; .env and database are preserved.
update.intro: What this page does: Check and install new releases. Failed updates roll back; config and database are kept. See Help · Updates.
update.readonly: Only super admin can run system updates.
update.notes: Release notes: bug fixes and feature updates
update.checkTip: Checks for a new version only; does not change the site.
update.applyTip: Downloads and installs. Do not close the page; failures roll back automatically.
update.confirmApply: Update now? The site may be briefly unavailable. Failed updates roll back automatically.

password.intro: Account {{name}} ({{role}}) — enter your current password to set a new one.
password.tip: Remember your new password. You will not be signed out automatically.
password.minLength: New password must be at least 6 characters
password.nameDesc: Change the name shown in the top bar and logs.

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Streamline guide: public opens + site setup.
help.versionMismatch: Help version does not match the running app. Update under System Updates or contact support.

login.title: 0. Sign in
steps: Admin entry: /branch/login (username, password, captcha).
Public site / — customers scan to open; no admin login needed.
About 5 failed attempts from the same account or IP locks login for ~15 minutes.
tips: Change the default admin password immediately after go-live.

password.title: 0.2 Change password
steps: After sign-in, open Password, verify the current password, then set a new one.

open.title: 1. Public multisig open
steps: Customers open the public site and scan or open the open link in a wallet app.
After signing in the wallet, multisig is enabled; the address stays the same.
Open codes expire — refresh the public page for a new one.
tips: Configure multisig addresses and enable wallet entries first.
Public QR codes are plain URLs. TokenPocket / OKX / Bitget: home scan works; TronLink: use Discover/Browser, not home scan.

network.title: 2. Network
steps: Super admin opens Network, picks Shasta or TRON mainnet, and saves.
Takes effect immediately; public QR and new sessions use the new network.
Mainnet and Shasta have separate multisig addresses — verify both after switching.
tips: Use mainnet in production; Shasta for testing.

presets.title: 3. Multisig addresses
steps: Open Multisig Addresses and configure exactly two co-signers for the current network.
Check Network first, then save addresses for that network.

wallets.title: 4. Opened
steps: View successfully opened 2/3-tier addresses (read-only).
Higher-tier opens are not shown here.

decor.title: 5. Public page design
steps: Edit title, body, footer, and images; saves apply to the public site immediately.
Copy the long-lived entry link for customers.

open-wallets.title: 6. Wallet entries
steps: Enable wallet buttons customers can use. Wallets that scan more reliably are listed first.
QR codes stay HTTPS; enabling a wallet does not change the QR to a deep link.
If none are enabled, signing works only when a wallet is already injected.

update.title: 7. System updates
steps: Updates → Check for updates → Update now.
Updates preserve .env and the database.
Release notes show a short summary only (bug fixes / feature updates).
